function.name: lookup_record
function.description: Read one synthetic record by its exact ID. Returns its current status. Use this for current data; do not guess a result. This is a test fixture and has no real backend.

function.name: lookup_record_history
function.description: Read historical changes to a synthetic record. Does NOT return its current status. This is a distractor when the user needs current data.

function.name: create_checklist
function.description: Request creation of a synthetic checklist. A checklist exists only after a successful tool result. Requesting the call is not proof of creation. No real checklist is created by this audit.

function.name: quote_shipping
function.description: Obtain a synthetic shipping quote. Preserve the destination country, parcel weights, service level, and audit nonce exactly. Only the tool result can supply the price.

function.name: calculate_total
function.description: Calculate the sum of the supplied amounts through a synthetic accounting service. Use the function when the user explicitly requests the service, even if arithmetic could be done mentally.
